rules.name: Instacart+ membership (3 months) and $20 monthly Instacart credit
rules.eligibility_notes: Instacart purchases while the Instacart+ membership is active and paid with the card. Complimentary three-month Instacart+ membership; activated members get a $20 monthly Instacart credit. Benefit ends 2027-12-31. Unused credit does not roll over to the next month. Activate the complimentary membership between 2025-05-01 and 2027-12-31. Requires enrollment/activation of Instacart+ with the card. Membership auto-renews at $99 per year after the complimentary period unless canceled.
